description: This Java test source file contains unit tests for the PersonVoidHandler class, which handles voiding (deactivating) Person objects in the OpenMRS system by setting relevant flags, reasons, and associated user and date information.

classes.name: PersonVoidHandlerTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for testing methods of the PersonVoidHandler class, specifically verifying that it correctly updates Person objects to be voided, sets reasons, users, dates, and retires associated users.

methods.name: handle_shouldSetThePersonVoidedBit
methods.description: Tests that the handle method marks a Person as voided by setting the personVoided flag to true.

methods.name: handle_shouldSetThePersonVoidReason
methods.description: Tests that the handle method sets the void reason on a Person object.

methods.name: handle_shouldSetPersonVoidedBy
methods.description: Tests that the handle method sets the user who voided the Person.

methods.name: handle_shouldNotSetPersonVoidedByIfNonNull
methods.description: Ensures that handle does not overwrite personVoidedBy if it is already set.

methods.name: handle_shouldSetPersonDateVoided
methods.description: Verifies that handle sets the date when the Person was voided.

methods.name: handle_shouldNotSetPersonDateVoidedIfNonNull
methods.description: Ensures that handle does not overwrite the Person's existing dateVoided if already set.

methods.name: handle_shouldNotSetThePersonVoidReasonIfAlreadyPersonVoided
methods.description: Checks that the handle method does not set a void reason if the Person is already marked as voided.

methods.name: handle_shouldRetireUsers
methods.description: Verifies that voiding a Person also results in associated User accounts being retired (deleted or deactivated).
